candidates.description: This feature vector activates on mathematical concepts related to infinity, limits, and growth rates.
This feature vector represents closing curly braces and various punctuation marks or symbols frequently attached to them.
This vector represents mathematical and logical operators, symbols, and algebraic expressions used in formal notation and programming.
This feature vector activates strongly on LaTeX mathematical typesetting commands and symbols.
This feature vector represents mathematical properties, functions, and classifications.
This vector represents mathematical operations and arithmetic relationships, particularly multiplication and division.
This vector represents comparative and superlative adjectives indicating degree, magnitude, or rate.
Mathematical terms and symbols representing quantities, values, and relations in equations.
These tokens function as conjunctive adverbs and logical transition words used to connect clauses and indicate relationships like cause, contrast, or sequence.
This vector is related to mathematical proof, verification, and logical demonstration.
